baseline_vs_final.rule: plan section 11: Production Gate A gap inventory not closed -> the PRODUCT_SHA will change -> every run under this freeze is BASELINE, never a final Gate W

p01_duration.T0: the instant choreo.py starts, which is after K1 was sampled

p02_resolution.x_root_note: X boots at 1280x1024 and is resized by the Activity; the check MUST run after the Activity bound. 2608 - 2191 = 417 px of system bars / cutout, as laid out by the Activity window.
p02_resolution.mismatch: BLOCKED before XFCE starts (run not consumed)

C1.why: XFCE package default; same compositor state as the historical B.1 census and B.2e run on :3, so it is comparable with them

C0.why: the user's daily :1 XFCE runs with use_compositing=false (~/.config/xfce4/xfconf/xfce-perchannel-xml/xfwm4.xml, read 2026-09-23); Gate W measures the daily desktop, so the baseline must show what that configuration actually sends to Gate A

p03_compositor.vblank_mode: off (pinned, not the package default auto: X3 advertises GLX, and auto would route through client-side Mesa, a CPU renderer in this PRoot)
p03_compositor.C1_C0_are_distinct_cells: never pooled, never compared as the same cell

p04_window_choreography.driver: choreo.py (xdotool 1:3.20160805.1-5build1), no manual input, no XTEST input events

p05_terminal.command: term_load.sh: one fixed 60-char line every 100 ms until <state_dir>/close-T<n> exists, then exit 0
p05_terminal.why_disable_server: one process per window, so a window's close is its own process exit with an observable rc

p06_open_close.close_mechanism: client-side: the flag file makes term_load.sh exit 0, the terminal exits, the window is destroyed by its owner
p06_open_close.timing: see p04 schedule: opens at 0/5/10/105/120, closes at 100/115/135/137/139

p07_resize.timing: every 2.5 s from t=70 to t=92.5, alternating, ending at 640x480

p08_redraw.screen_saver: xset s off -dpms on :3 before the session, so no blanking interrupts the window

p09_expected_gatea_traffic.eligible_shape: PictOpOver, src a8r8g8b8, dst x8r8g8b8, no mask, no transform/repeat, filter Nearest, no componentAlpha/alphaMap, src != dst (InitOutput.c lorieCanAccelCompositePictures)

predicted_sources.C1: xfwm4 compositor frame shadows (ARGB32 Over onto the x8r8g8b8 root buffer) plus client content
predicted_sources.C0: client content only: GTK3/cairo icons and ARGB images drawn Over into depth-24 windows

p09_expected_gatea_traffic.registry_note: cmdentrypoint.cpp LORIE_GATEA_XREGISTRY_SIZE 16. A new distinct buffer while full is refused (gateAEnsureReady returns FALSE) and the composite legally takes the D0a staging path (Gcomp FDCLONE) - NOT an error, and NOT CPU.
p09_expected_gatea_traffic.generation: exactly 1 for the whole session (D-06); exactly one GATEA_BIND for the X pid

steps: all terminals closed by their own exit (schedule t=135/137/139)
xfce4-session-logout --logout --fast, with the session's own DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS
wait <= logout_timeout_s for the xfce4-session process tree to be gone
K3 sample: X alive with zero XFCE clients (-noreset keeps it up)
p_r10_ledger --mode terminate: GiveUp -> DE_TERMINATE -> CloseScreen (the R10 clean close)
K4 sample: X gone, Activity alive and UNBOUND (D-06 section 2.4)
am force-stop com.waydefu.x11gpu (cleanup, after all evidence is taken)
p10_shutdown_path.why_r8_arm: the LORIE-R8-TEST extension provides the only qualified clean close on dc94485. R8-C1 carries no fault; case-dependent code is confined to the test extension's own requests (lorie_r8_test.c :147/:412), which no XFCE client sends, so render paths are unchanged.
never: SIGTERM/SIGKILL of X as a shutdown (it does not reach CloseScreen and r-hups the renderer)
killing any XFCE process as part of the clean path
p10_shutdown_path.if_logout_times_out: INVALID shutdown_unclean; remaining session pids are killed by exact pid as cleanup and recorded
p10_shutdown_path.launch: start-x3-untraced.sh with the p10 launch_env passed explicitly; X3 stdout/stderr to /data/data/com.termux/files/usr/tmp/x3-launch-<run>.log, copied into the evidence

k_points.K0: X + Activity bound, root size verified, before any XFCE process
k_points.K1: session ready + settle_after_ready_s, immediately before T0
k_points.K2: T0 + 150 s (end of choreography), before logout
k_points.K3: after logout, X alive, zero XFCE clients
k_points.K4: after the clean close, X gone, Activity alive

at_every_k: r10_sample.py (x + activity process metrics, dumpsys meminfo GPU rows)

continuous.logcat: raw logcat for the whole run (GATEA_EVENT, LorieNative 5 s lines, Probe ENTER/RETURN, Gcomp Prepare/FDCLONE, R8_OBS, GATEA_*)

derived.composite_total: sum of xrender_ops over X-pid 'frames in 5.0 seconds' lines inside [T0, T0+150) (5 s windows attributed by the line's timestamp)
derived.xrender_5s: sum over X-pid 'frames in 5.0 seconds' lines whose timestamp falls inside the window: frames, present offload/attempt, EXA copy offload/attempt/cpu_rects, solid gpu/fallback, xrender_ops, exa_comp_check T/F, prepare T/F, gpu_rects, cpu_rects, done
derived.gatea_direct: count of GATEA_EVENT event=5 (LEASE_GPU_OWNED) inside the window
derived.d0a_staged: prepare_true - gatea_direct when events are complete; null otherwise
derived.gatea_hit_rate: gatea_direct / exa_comp_check_true; null if the denominator is 0
derived.gpu_composite_share: prepare_true / composite_total; null if composite_total is 0
derived.frames_sf: unique SurfaceFlinger BLAST-layer frames with actualPresent inside the window
derived.frame_interval_ms_p50_p95_p99: consecutive actualPresent deltas inside the window
derived.jank_frames: frames with present_lag > 33.33 ms (4 vsync periods at 120 Hz; the pipeline's typical lag is ~2, measured 12-18 ms in probe-02)
derived.sf_coverage: complete iff every consecutive pair of polls overlaps (oldest frame of poll k+1 <= newest frame of poll k); otherwise the frame metrics are null, never partial
derived.gpu_busy: mean of busy/total over the gpubusy polls inside the window (system-wide, includes Stable and SurfaceFlinger)
derived.thermal: max skin / max CPU / max GPU HAL temperature and max thermal status over the run
derived.stable_background_fps: Stable's own LorieNative 5 s frame counts inside the window, read passively from logcat - a covariate, not a Stable interaction
derived.upload_bytes: null - B3a telemetry is NOT enabled in this freeze (default-off diagnostic, would add per-op timing); V2-B3-TELEMETRY-VERIFY decides it
derived.diag_stamp_lines: count of X-pid lines starting with a p2a2 stamp prefix over the whole run; must be 0

p11_metrics.null_rule: unmeasurable is null, never 0; a metric null in one run and numeric in another is reported, not averaged

k_alignment_with_r10.K3: B1 (session over, X alive, no client)

hard_exact_from_close_summary: generationFatal == 0 and firstFailed == 0 on the summary line

soft_from_r10_tolerance.outcome_when_exceeded: FINDING (feeds D-04 / gap inventory), not a verdict failure: R10 established that only counters are exact

p13_crash_proof: X pid identical at K0, K1, K2, K3 and gone only after terminate, with a GATEA_SUMMARY where=x-close-screen
zero 'Fatal signal', 'GATEA_FATAL_HALT', 'Abort message', ' F DEBUG ' lines from the X or Activity pid
xfwm4, xfce4-panel, xfdesktop pids identical at K1 and K2 (xfce4-session restarts a crashed client, so a pid change IS a crash)
no close summary in either source while the logcat capture WAS alive = X did not reach CloseScreen = crash proof FAIL
every xfce4-terminal exits within close_exit_timeout_s of its close flag (terminals_exited)

BLOCKED_not_consumed: screen not awake or keyguard showing at preflight
INVALID: a choreography step failed (window not found, xdotool rc != 0, close did not exit)
a step executed more than step_lateness_invalid_s late
logcat capture not alive at the end
no close summary in either source (gatea-summary.txt, X-pid GATEA_SUMMARY logcat line) while the logcat capture was NOT alive - a capture failure, not information
any X-pid diagnostic stamp line (TERMUX_X11_P2A_DIAG was on)
screen not awake / keyguard showing after the clean close (it went off mid-run)
validity.events_incomplete: GATEA_EVENT seq not contiguous 0..nextSequence-1 -> event-derived metrics and the event-stream balance check are null; counters still judge; the run stays valid

classes.BASELINE_VALID: valid, crash proof PASS, every hard resource check PASS (soft findings listed)
classes.BASELINE_DEFECT: valid enough to judge, and crash proof FAIL or a hard resource check FAIL -> product-defect evidence for V2-PGA-GAP-INVENTORY
classes.INVALID: the workload did not happen as frozen - no information
classes.BLOCKED: stopped before XFCE started - not consumed

verdict.precedence: a crash is never downgraded to INVALID: if the crash proof fails, the verdict is BASELINE_DEFECT even when later steps could not run

runs.why_interleaved: spreads thermal and background-load drift across both variants instead of loading it onto the later one

session_env.launcher: dbus-run-session -- <session_wrapper> (the wrapper records DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS, then execs xfce4-session)
session_env.autostart: every /etc/xdg/autostart/*.desktop is overridden with Hidden=true in <run>/config/autostart; the session is exactly the system Failsafe client list
session_env.run_root: /tmp/xfce-x3-run-<id> (the Termux tmp bind), removed after its logs are copied into the evidence

frozen_before_any_xfce_session_note: no XFCE session has run with the untraced X3 launch before this freeze
